en.headline: Inter Milan beat Manchester City on penalties at Kai Tak Stadium
en.dek: The Italian champions won 3-1 in the shootout after a 1-1 draw in the opening match of the Hong Kong Football Festival, with Divin Mubama scoring for City.
body: Inter Milan defeated Manchester City 3-1 on penalties after the sides finished 1-1 in the opening fixture of the Hong Kong Football Festival at Kai Tak Stadium on Saturday evening. Divin Mubama scored the first goal of Enzo Maresca’s tenure as Manchester City manager in the 14th minute, but Benjamin Pavard equalised for the Italian side.

The match, part of the Asahi Super Dry Trophy, drew an attendance of 42,826. Maresca said Inter had started training earlier and were probably more ready, though his team improved in the second half. Young winger Ryan McAidoo was among those who impressed after coming on.
The result marked the start of Manchester City’s Asia tour. The Hong Kong Football Festival continues later in the week with Chelsea facing Juventus at the same venue.

zh.headline: 國際米蘭十二碼擊敗曼城 凱旋體育場足球節揭幕戰
zh.dek: 意甲冠軍於香港足球節揭幕戰1比1賽和後，以3比1贏十二碼勝出，曼城新帥任內首球由穆巴馬打進。
body: 國際米蘭於星期六晚在啟德體育場舉行的香港足球節揭幕戰中，與曼城1比1賽和後，以3比1贏得十二碼大戰。曼城新任主帥馬雷斯卡任內首球由穆巴馬於第14分鐘攻入，但國際米蘭的柏華特扳平比數。
這場屬於朝日超爽獎盃的賽事吸引42,826名觀眾入場。馬雷斯卡表示國際米蘭較早展開操練，狀態可能較佳，但球隊下半場表現有所改善。後備上陣的年輕邊鋒麥艾度亦有出色表現。
賽果標誌曼城亞洲之旅展開。香港足球節稍後將繼續，車路士將在同一場地迎戰祖雲達斯。
